operations.name: app.guide
operations.description: What the app is, how songs are written in ABC with words (w: lines), the levels, the vocalises, the microphone's limits, the health rules…

topic.description: one part only: protocol|words|recordings|abc|health|levels|curriculum (all when left out)

operations.name: app.state
operations.description: The shell's one call: settings, the voice, today's health and load, unread coach messages, the open session.

operations.name: app.context
operations.description: What the person is looking at right now (view, song, bars, mode, key, lesson or drill) and their voice.

operations.name: settings.get
operations.description: The settings.

operations.name: voice.get
operations.description: The singer's voice: measured range, comfortable range, voice family and clef, passaggio estimate, sustain, history of range tests.

operations.name: health.get
operations.description: Voice health: today's load against the cap, light or rest day, flags (heavy yesterday, pain, bad check-in, ramp, see a doctor), voice…

operations.name: songs.list
operations.description: The library (lean for the agent): id, title, level, language, range and span, status, key shift, sections with stages.

q.description: words of the title, composer or first words

operations.name: songs.get
operations.description: One song: details, sections and stages, its fit for this voice, recent takes; --abc true adds the notation.

operations.name: songs.check
operations.description: Check ABC notation with words without saving: every problem by line, verse and bar, the singing checks for the level (span, breath…

abc.description: the notation; pass it from a file: --abc "$(cat song.abc)"

song.description: check it as a change to this song (the rules songs.update applies), with what it changes

operations.name: songs.add
operations.description: Add a song or vocalise (refused with every problem listed when the notation, words, span or source are not right).

message.description: id of the message that asked for it

note.description: one tip, shown on the practice screen

gloss.description: word-for-word English for songs in another language

duplicate.description: add another version of a title

operations.name: songs.update
operations.description: Change a song's details, its sections, the coach's note, the gloss or the notation (sections whose bars did not change keep their progress).

operations.name: songs.words
operations.description: A song's words bar by bar: each sung note with its syllable in each verse, and the notation line it is written on.

bars.description: a bar or a range, e.g. 4-7

operations.name: songs.shift-words
operations.description: Move a verse's words one note earlier (--by -1) or later (--by 1), from one note to the end of its phrase (or of the song): the fix for…

bar.description: the bar of the first syllable to move (as songs.words numbers it)

note.description: which sung note of that bar, from 1 (default 1)

operations.name: songs.set-words
operations.description: Lay words on the sung notes of some bars, in order: spaces part words, hyphens part syllables, each Japanese, Chinese or Korean character…

bars.description: a bar or a range, e.g. 4-7

text.description: the words, e.g. "sa-i go no ki-su wa"

operations.name: runs.list
operations.description: Recent takes with their numbers (pitch share, in-tune share, cents bias, steadiness, vibrato, timing).

operations.name: runs.get
operations.description: One take in detail: per phrase and per note (status, cents, onset, scoop/fall/vibrato flags).

operations.name: sessions.list
operations.description: Practice sessions: minutes, voiced minutes, vocal dose, warm-up and cool-down, songs, reviews.

operations.name: sessions.get
operations.description: One session with its takes.

operations.name: sessions.review
operations.description: The coach writes the session's review (3-6 sentences; writing again replaces it).

operations.name: review.pack
operations.description: Everything to review a session, under about 6,000 characters: takes with numbers, the weakest phrase and its words, stage changes, drills…

operations.name: coach.list
operations.description: The conversation.

operations.name: coach.get
operations.description: One message of the person's with what they were looking at, the conversation before it, their level, voice and health.

operations.name: coach.reply
operations.description: The coach answers a message (songs added with --message show under it).

message.description: id of the message answered (coach.list shows the pending ones)

new.description: a message nobody asked for (instead of --message)

operations.name: coach.unsend
operations.description: Take back one of the coach's own messages (a mistake): within 30 minutes and before the person has read it; the question it answered waits…

operations.name: plan.today
operations.description: Today's plan (stored, or the rules' plan): blocks with kind, minutes, why, sitting.

operations.name: plan.set
operations.description: The coach proposes a plan (today if not started, else tomorrow), checked against the health rules: warm-up first (5 min+), cool-down last…

blocks.description: a JSON list of blocks (see app.guide) (JSON)

operations.name: stats.home
operations.description: The dashboard: 30 days of minutes, voiced minutes, pitch and in-tune shares, steadiness; streak; level; voice; load; voice map; songs in…

operations.name: stats.song
operations.description: One song over time: tempo ladders per section, minutes and pitch share per day, trouble bars.

operations.name: stats.voice
operations.description: The voice over time: range tests, steadiness, sustain, health and load, the voice map.

operations.name: learn.state
operations.description: The curriculum and the path (lean for the agent): level, lessons done, the next lesson, the weakest requirement and skill, what the level…

operations.name: drills.list
operations.description: Recent drill runs.

operations.name: abc.parse
operations.description: Parse notation into the practice model without saving.

operations.name: models.part
operations.description: One 16 MB part of a model file the page uses to turn a recording into a song: Demucs (voice and music apart) and Whisper (the words)…
